title: picker min width 2x height
rule: Minimum width 2× field-button height — quiet pickers have no minimum; width follows text.
pass_when: Non-quiet picker width is at least 2× field-button height. Quiet picker width follows text (no minimum).
fail_when: Non-quiet picker narrower than 2× height, or a quiet-picker minimum invented in-house.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
